description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/column_nonuniform_1d_tracer/rules/varcoeff_face_laplacian_lev_flux_bc_tracer driven by problems/heat_column_varcoeff_flux_bc_tracer.esm (two tracers, NTRACER=2 bound at the import edge; shared constant interface coefficient alpha; per-tracer prescribed K du/dz = alpha a_s at both interfaces). The problem file is loaded once per resolution with the loader-API NLEV binding (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4). Both tracers' ramps are discretely exact, tracer 1 is heat_column_varcoeff_flux_bc and tracer 2 has half its cosine amplitude, so the error field is the 1-D problem's in tracer 1 and exactly half of it in tracer 2, and the recorded (relative) L2 errors at t=0.1 fall as O(dz^2) like tests/conformance/convergence/heat_column_varcoeff_flux_bc's.
